capabilities: Convert natural-language math phrases between ;; markers to LaTeX automatically
Convert selected text to LaTeX via command
Parse English and Italian math vocabulary
Configure inline, block, or no LaTeX delimiters
disambiguation: Despite the name, it converts plain-language phrases into LaTeX; the manifest also mentions tables and charts, but the README documents only math constructs.
extras: Not in the community plugin store; manual installation from GitHub Releases only. The manifest description claims tables and charts support, which the README does not cover. Documentation is duplicated in English and Italian.
problem: Writing LaTeX math syntax by hand is slow and requires memorizing commands for integrals, limits, sums, roots and Greek letters.
summary: Natural-language-to-LaTeX converter that turns typed math phrases like "integral of x" into LaTeX code between markers or on selection.
